en.title: Nidingen Bird Ringing Station
en.subtitle: Historical Bird Ringing Data from Nidingen Field Station · Data from {start} to {end}
en.pheno_desc: Explore migration patterns throughout the year. Birds are captured during spring (northward) and autumn (southward) migration periods.
en.weather_desc: Meteorological observations from SMHI Nidingen A (station 71190) supplemented by Vinga A (station 71380) where Nidingen lacks data.
en.weather_nid_legend_desc: Temperature, wind, humidity, cloud cover, gust wind: full archive 1980–present. Precipitation: 1980–2007. Pressure: 1980–1995. Visibility: 1980–2007.
en.weather_ving_legend_desc: Precipitation: 2007–present (gap-fills Nidingen). Pressure: 1996–present (gap-fills Nidingen). Visibility: 2007–present (gap-fills Nidingen). Full Vinga archive stored separately in weather_data_vinga.
